```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(MuMIn)
library(broom)


library(tidyverse) 
library(cowplot) 
library(sjPlot) 
library(sjmisc) 
library(sjstats)

library(GGally)

#read data with summarized performance above average
data_paa <- readRDS("data_paa.rds")
```

```{r}
#select included data parameters
paa_param <- c("augmentation",
               "architecture", 
               "epochs", 
               "learning_rate", 
               "Classification.level",
               "num_class", 
               "num_img", 
               "curation", 
               "PAA",
               "id")

#select included numerical data parameters
paa_param_num <- c("epochs", 
                   "learning_rate", 
                   "num_class", 
                   "num_img", 
                   "PAA")

#convert categorical values to factors
#filter for only rows with all parameter values filled
#remove unnecessary columns
data_paa_param <- data_paa %>% 
  mutate(architecture = as.factor(architecture),
         curation = as.factor(curation)) %>% 
  filter(if_all(all_of(paa_param), 
                ~ !is.na(.))) %>% 
  select(-author, 
         -journal, 
         -year, 
         -citations)
```

```{r}
#ensures model is not fit unless data is complete (i.e. checks work of above)
options(na.action = "na.fail")

#fit m1, all parameters
m1 <- lmer(PAA ~ scale(num_img) + scale(num_class) + scale(epochs) + scale(learning_rate) + curation + augmentation + Classification.level + (1 | architecture) + (1 | id), 
           data = data_paa_param)
summary(m1)

#augmentation no longer included due to correlation with image number
data_aug_mean <- data_paa_param %>% 
  group_by(augmentation) %>% 
  summarise(mean_num_img = mean(num_img), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(data_aug_mean, 
       aes(x = augmentation,
           y = mean_num_img,
           fill = augmentation))+
  geom_col() +
  theme_classic()

#dredging m1
m1_dredge <- dredge(m1)
m1_dredge

#fit m2 based on dredge results + augmentation correlation with num_img
m2 <- lmer(PAA ~ curation + scale(num_img) + (1 | architecture) + (1 | id), 
           data = data_paa_param)
summary(m2)

#fit m3 with interaction between epochs & learning_rate, num_img & num_class
m3 <- lmer(PAA ~ scale(num_img) * scale(num_class) + scale(epochs) * scale(learning_rate) + curation + Classification.level + (1 | architecture) + (1 | id),
               data = data_paa_param)
summary(m3)

#dredging m3
m3_dredge <- dredge(m3)
m3_dredge #0 delta AIC shows the same factors as m2

#comparison information statistics between m1 m2 and m3
AICc(m1, m2, m3, k = 2)

#averaging models below the delta threshold in m3 to improve fit
m3_avg <- model.avg(m3_dredge, subset = delta < 6, fit = TRUE)

summary(m3_avg)
```

```{r}
tab_model(m2)

fitted <- predict(m2)
residuals <- resid(m2)

data_m2_fr <- data.frame(fitted,
                           residuals)

data_m2_plot <- data_m2_fr %>% 
  merge(bind_cols(select(data_paa_param, PAA)))

ggplot(data = data_m2_plot,
       aes(x = fitted,
           y = residuals
       )) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line(y = 0) +
  theme_classic()

qqnorm(residuals)
hist(residuals)

data_m2_obs <- data.frame(
  fitted = predict(m2, data_paa_param),
  observed = data_paa_param$PAA
)

data_m3avg_obs <- data.frame(
  fitted = predict(m3_avg, data_paa_param),  # pass data explicitly for averaged models
  observed = data_paa_param$PAA
)

p_m2 <- ggplot(data_m2_obs, aes(x = fitted, y = observed)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, 
              linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "M2", x = "Fitted PAA", y = "Observed PAA") +
  theme_classic()


plot_model(m2,
           type = "pred")

plot_model(m2,
           type = "est")
```
